description.value: An Indigenous-owned day spa located at Halcyon Hot Springs Resort on the shores of Upper Arrow Lake, operated by Pamela Joy Howse (Red Hawk Woman), an Oji-Cree wellness practitioner with over 20 years of experience. Services range from massages, facials, and reiki to yoga, life coaching, stand-up paddleboarding, and mindfulness nature walks, with a strong emphasis on Indigenous culture and land stewardship. For a touring cyclist, it offers a genuine restorative stop in a scenic Kootenays setting, blending wellness treatments with outdoor and cultural experiences.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is active (© 2026, active job postings, events listed). The phone number 250-265-0549 and email info@thespaathalcyon.ca appear on multiple pages; the website URL matches OSM. No bicycle-specific amenities (parking, showers, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all such fields default to null. The careers page references 'free access to healing mineral pools' as a staff perk, but this does not confirm drop-in shower access for guests.
concerns: OSM record has no address, phone, or structured tags — very minimal record; address should be confirmed (Halcyon Hot Springs Resort, Nakusp area, BC).
OSM osm_id is empty, suggesting this may be a manually added candidate rather than a true OSM node.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Indigenous-owned spa and wellness attraction at Halcyon Hot Springs Resort; website confirms ongoing operations, staffing, and events as of 2026.
enrichment_extras.notes: The careers page mentions staff receive free access to healing mineral pools, but this is an employee benefit and does not confirm drop-in pool/shower access for spa clients without further verification.
